title: Haye Abbas Haye Abbas
body:
Abbas Abbas
Haaye
Qatl jab hogaya maidan mein Abbas e Ali
Haye Abbas ke girye se fiza goonj uthi
Haye Abbas, Haye Abbas ×2
Jalte khaimon se sada aayi sar e Karbobala
Haye Abbas Haye Abbas ×2
Lo khabar jald ke ab bistare Sajjad jala
Haye Abbas Haye Abbas ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tanha atthaara baradar ki behen hai ban mein
Neend kyu aagayi aye bhai batado ran mein
Neend se jaago chhini Zainab e muztar ki rida
Haye Abbas....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mere ghazi mere safdar mere mir e lashkar
Dekh be aas hai pardes mein teri khwahar
Kat gaya sibt e payambar ka, bhi sajde me gala
Haye Abbas....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Bain karti hui laashe pe chali aaungi
Kitne naasoor kaleje mein hai dikhlaaungi
Meri taqdeer mein kuch bhi nahi ashkon ke siwaa
Haye Abbas....
Haaye,
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mera Akbar mera Qasim, mera Asghar na raha
Do mere laal the dono mein se koi na bacha
Na koi bhai bhateeja na koi hai beta
Haye Abbas....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bhaiyon se to badi aas hua karti hai
Har behen bhai ke haq me ye dua karti hai
Umr lag jayen meri zinda rahe bhai mera
Haye Abbas....
Haaye,
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jee ke ab kya karu aye bhai tumhare ghum mein
Zindagi guzregi Zainab ki tere matam mein
Mujhko tadpaayegi aye bhai teri yaad sada
Haye Abbas....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khaali quze liye bacche hai dare khaima par
Suwe dariya hai lagi bali Sakina Ki nazar
Kehti hai bacchon se aate hai abhi mere chacha
Haye Abbas....
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Noha Rehan ye Zainab ka tha baade Abbas
Kyu nahi karte ho Abbas hamara ehsaas
Qafila be saron samaan suwe shaam chala
Haye Abbas Haye Abbas ×4
